title: Add invoice Ageing Days and improve Clear Old Data control

requirements.text: Update the Admin "Invoice Management" page to present the existing destructive data reset action as a clear "Clear Old Data" button (admin-only) while keeping the current confirmation dialog safety step.

quotes: Okay add clear old data button..now add more button in Ageing days which cout from invoice date to so it easier to clear old invoice first

acceptanceCriteria: On the Invoice Management page (frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPage.tsx), the admin-only destructive action is clearly labeled as "Clear Old Data" (user-facing text).
The confirmation dialog remains required before the reset is executed.
The reset still calls the existing React Query mutation hook (useClearAllData) and shows success/failure toasts as it does today.
Non-admin users do not see the "Clear Old Data" control.

requirements.text: Add an "Ageing Days" feature to the invoices list so users can easily identify and prioritize older invoices: compute ageing as the number of days from each invoice's Invoice Date to today, display it in the invoices table, and provide a UI control to sort invoices by ageing (oldest first / newest first).

quotes: now add more button in Ageing days which cout from invoice date to so it easier to clear old invoice first

acceptanceCriteria: The invoices table (frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesTable.tsx) includes a new column labeled "Ageing Days" that displays an integer day count for each invoice based on Invoice Date -> today.

A sort control is available for Ageing Days (e.g., a button or clickable column header) that toggles sort order between oldest-first and newest-first, and the current sort direction is visible in the UI.
Sorting by Ageing Days reorders the displayed invoices accordingly (and works together with existing Search & Filter behavior on the Invoice Management page).
If an invoice date cannot be parsed into a valid date, the Ageing Days cell shows a safe fallback (e.g., "—"), and sorting places these rows consistently (e.g., at the bottom) without runtime errors.
No backend schema or storage changes are required for Ageing Days; it is computed client-side from the existing invoiceDate text field.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui (immutable paths).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not implement backend-side ageing calculations or persistence for ageing days.
Do not add new reset modes (e.g., reset by date range) unless explicitly requested.
Do not change existing payment entry workflows, validation rules, or report calculations as part of this change.
